messages:
kevin_partnerships: Quick sync — we're running an "Open House" for the cloud marketplace launch next Wed 9am PT. Goal: press preview, HW partner certification signoff, SI onboarding demo cadence. Need owners + any blockers by EOD tomorrow.
maria: I'll own press coordination. embargo window? who has PR draft?
sarah_pm: I have draft blog + landing copy in /docs/drafts. Need final logos from partners and one-line partner quotes. ETA Tue noon for content lock.
aj: SI onboarding: we have 2 SIs ready to run end-to-end tests next week. Need service accounts + staging catalog entries. Who can provision?
leo_eng: Hardware cert status: QA found fp16 perf regression on p4d-24xlarge. Working on kernel pin; expected patch by tomorrow afternoon. Might shift certification to Thurs.
kevin_partnerships: @maria thanks. @sarah_pm can you slot partner quotes? @aj @leo_eng for provisioning — @ops-team? :slightly_smiling_face:
ops-team: we can create staging catalog entries. Need list: partner IDs + model slugs + desired region. Send in this thread or a spreadsheet.
maria: Press embargo target is Tue 10am PT. If cert slips to Thu, we either delay embargo or publish press about marketplace (no partner badges) and do partner follow-up. Thoughts?
sarah_pm: Lean toward pushing partner-specific callouts to a follow-up (less risk). We can still run open house with partners invited.
aj: For SI demo, we need a stable model endpoint and sample tenant. Ops — can you pre-provision a tenant with mock billing & RBAC for the SIs?
ops-team: yes — create a ticket with tenant name, test users, and regions. We'll aim for provisioning within 24h.
leo_eng: Quick note: if we enable KV cache bypass for the certified models tests, we can avoid the fp16 perf path. Will validate with the kernel patch.
kevin_partnerships: Action list (small):
- maria: press embargo + partner outreach (due EOD tomorrow)
- sarah_pm: lock landing copy + partner quote slots (Tue noon)
- aj: SI test plan + demo schedule (share by EOD)
- leo_eng: hw cert fix verification (tomorrow)
- ops-team: staging catalog + tenant provisioning (ticket now)
If anyone can't meet timelines, call it out here. We'll run a 20-min sync tomorrow 10:30am PT to surface blockers. :calendar:
deploy-bot: Reminder: staging cutover window tomorrow 1am-3am PT. Please avoid schema changes during cutover.
maria: on it — pinging PR team and partners now. Will post partner logo pack link once received.
sarah_pm: I'll move landing to "partner-fallback" state so we can live without badges if needed.
